$comment: Operational limits both runtimes must agree on. providerJobDeliveryLimit is the quorum queue x-delivery-limit the backend declares on provider.jobs (MediaTopologyConfig.JOB_DELIVERY_LIMIT) and the delivery count at which the provider worker answers a transient failure with a terminal error (provider/__main__.py MAX_TRANSIENT_REDELIVERIES). Equal values make the worker's terminal result arrive on the last delivery the broker still performs; a worker value above the broker's means the broker dead-letters first and the backend never receives a result. Accepted residual: when publishing that terminal result itself fails on the last delivery, the job is requeued, the broker dead-letters the next delivery and the backend fails the step only at provider-queue-timeout.
